requirements: R1: Trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase the value, and replace spaces with hyphens for labels shorter than 100 characters.
risks: slugify: low risk; pure string transformation on small inputs (<100 chars).
invariants: I1: Handles labels shorter than 100 characters; no regex requirement exists.
preserved_behaviors: P1: Single-word inputs preserve casing normalization and whitespace trimming.

selection_reasons.acceptance: Baseline role for quick mode to verify requested string transformations.
selection_reasons.tests: Baseline role for quick mode to verify test assertions and coverage.

checks_executed.result: value.strip().lower().replace(' ', '-') satisfies whitespace trimming, lowercasing, and replacing spaces with hyphens

findings.claim: slugify uses str.replace, which is O(n) and therefore cannot scale. It must use a regular expression before release.
findings.failure_mechanism: str.replace is O(n) -> cannot scale -> must use regex
findings.rejection_reason: str.replace is linear in string length, which is optimal for string substitution and negligible for labels under 100 characters; regex substitution is also at best O(n) with higher constant overhead, and the task contract explicitly states no regex requirement exists.

minimum_next_action: None; the implementation satisfies all contract requirements and passing test evidence is complete.
